# Jeremiah 11 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 11:20 (overlap: 3%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | But-YHWH-of hosts, judging righteously, testing [the]-kidneys and-[the]-heart, let-me-see Your-vengeance upon-them, for to-You I-have-revealed my-case. |
| LOGOS | But, O LORD of hosts, who judges righteously, who tests the heart and the mind, let me see Your vengeance upon them, for to You have I committed my cause. |
| PNEUMA | But LORD of Armies, You are a righteous judge! You examine the deepest thoughts and secrets. Let me see You take revenge on these people, for I have committed my cause to You. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

| LOGOS | Therefore thus says the LORD concerning the men of Anathoth, who seek your life, and say, "Do not prophesy in the name of the LORD, or you will die by our hand" — |
| PNEUMA | So the LORD spoke about the men of my hometown, Anathoth, who wanted me dead. They told me, "Stop prophesying in the LORD's name, or we will kill you!" |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
